svg.title: PN: Vp-Vn=-1.0 V Common x / row scales Approximate SCR n,p; depletion rho
svg.desc: Same x and row scales for doping, SCR approximate n/p, depletion rho, negative electric field and potential. Boundary approximation is not full transport.
